notes.title: We are Sigma Studios
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!

We’re Sigma Studios, working heart and soul on our debut game, Omen! A heartfelt shoutout to everyone who has been a part of this journey, lending us support and sharing their time. Your vibes mean the world to us!

We’ve been hearing your questions, and we’re here to share our heart and spirit with you all!

**Why are we rocking Unity?**
We want Omen to break the boundaries and be accessible to everyone, everywhere. With Unity, we’re blending our passion and creativity to show it's not about the tools but the craftsmen. Let’s prove the magic together!

**Wondering about Omen’s appearance?**
We’re opening our doors to you, showcasing the evolution of Omen. Right now, our heartbeat is syncing with developing the soul of the game—the backend. Everything visual, from models to animations, is bound to morph into something distinct and extraordinary. We’re dedicated to launching Omen with assets that resonate with our essence!

Meanwhile, we’re proud to illuminate the brilliant creators whose work we’re adopting temporarily from the Unity store. A spotlight page is on its way to honor their incredible creations!

For us, gaming is a tapestry of shared passion and myriad creators. It’s crucial for us to respect and celebrate each creator’s unique flavor and contribution.

Your being here, reading this, sharing this journey, and contributing your spirit, is deeply appreciated! Here’s to more passion, creativity, and shared dreams! A cascade of love and good vibes from Sigma Studios!

With all our hearts,
Sigma Studios Team
